recommendations.description: 🚨 CRITICAL SECURITY ISSUES: (1) Hardcoded API key in subscriptionService.ts must be moved to environment variables immediately. (2) Credit card data being logged in paymentUtils.ts - PCI compliance violation. (3) Missing input validation on email parameter. These issues MUST be fixed before any production deployment.

Payment-related code has ZERO test coverage. This is unacceptable for production code handling financial transactions. Create comprehensive tests for: subscription creation/cancellation, payment processing, error scenarios, and all validation logic.
Add proper error handling for all Stripe API calls. Currently missing try/catch blocks and error callbacks. Implement graceful error handling with user-friendly messages.
Create Stripe client wrapper class to encapsulate API details and centralize error handling. Extract validation logic into separate, testable functions.
Add accessibility attributes: alt text for images, aria-labels for interactive elements, proper heading hierarchy in PremiumBanner component.
